summary: Three Heading samples: a fluid display headline, a smaller display-3 heading and an h2 element drawn at the h4 size.
use: Rendering an editorial or marketing headline in the display font with its own tracking and leading, or decoupling a heading's look from its level.
spec: `<Heading level={1} size="display">` renders an h1 in the display text role
`<Heading level={2} size="display-3">` renders an h2 at the smallest fluid display size
`<Heading level={2} size="h4">` renders an h2 with the h4 look
